## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI or hardware changes, include device / Android API / ABI and a redacted screenshot or log. State any checks you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant build, lint and Python checks pass (or gaps are explained above)
- [ ] Changed behavior has appropriate regression coverage
- [ ] User-facing docs and compatibility evidence are updated where needed
- [ ] No credentials, private chats or personal data in code, logs or images
- [ ] Upstream `vendor/` remains unmodified
